source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
This changes how enemy units **Fall Back** from the bearer's unit. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

- If an enemy unit that is not a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** is picked to Fall Back while in **Engagement Range** of the bearer's unit, its models face **Desperate Escape tests** as though the unit were **Battle-shocked**.
- Should that enemy unit be Battle-shocked by something else as well, each of those tests takes a -1 modifier.

effects.trigger: an enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer's unit is chosen to Fall Back
effects.effect: its models take Desperate Escape tests as if it were Battle-shocked
